selection_detail: CHURN_FILES from git (since 2026-08-24): frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx (x3), frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/lib/api.ts (x2) both fall under ppt-web-core root frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/ (contexts/, lib/, hooks/, routes/). ppt-web-core had the most churn hits of any reviewable segment. Not saturated: 0 open code-review-finding items for ppt-web-core in backlog.json.

evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/routes/groups/rentals.tsx:517-521 (GuestRegistrationPageRoute): the route fetches real guest data (rentalsApiListGuests, line 483) and groups it into bookingsWithPendingGuests, but every action the page exposes is a no-op stub — onRegisterGuest={() => {}}, onRegisterAllGuests={() => {}}, onEditGuest={() => {}}, onAddGuest={() => {}}. The guest-registration screen (its entire reason for existing) renders functional buttons that silently do nothing; no toast, no navigation, no mutation. Unlike RentalsCalendarPageRoute/TaxReportPageRoute these are NOT documented as 'no endpoint yet', so this reads as unfinished wiring, not an intentional stub.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/routes/groups/rentals.tsx:333-339 (PlatformConnectionsPageRoute): onConnect/onDisconnect/onSettings are all () => {} even though the same component wires working createConnection + syncPlatforms mutations (lines 302-323). A user can create/sync a platform connection but Disconnect and Settings buttons are dead.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/routes/groups/rentals.tsx:381-383 (BookingsPageRoute): onCancelBooking/onCheckIn/onCheckOut are () => {} despite BookingDetailPageRoute (lines 409-429) already implementing working checkIn/checkOut mutations via rentalsApiCheckIn/rentalsApiCheckOut. Check-in/out from the bookings list is dead while the same action works one screen deeper. Landable frontend-only remedy: wire these handlers to the existing rentals API client mutations (register-guest / check-in / check-out / disconnect) that already back the sibling routes, or hide the affordances until backed.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/routes/groups/financial.tsx:70-136 (FinancialDashboardPageRoute): three useQuery calls (getARAgingReport, getOverdueInvoices, listInvoices) destructure ONLY isLoading — never isError/error. On any backend failure the values fall back to zeros/empties (totals => {current:0,...,total:0}, invoices => [], overdueInvoices => []) and the page is handed isLoading only, no error prop. Result: if the AR-aging or invoices endpoint 500s, the manager's financial dashboard renders totalOutstanding/totalOverdue/totalBalance = €0 with NO error indication — a load failure is indistinguishable from 'nothing is due', which is a decision-integrity hazard on a financial screen.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/routes/groups/financial.tsx:456-459 shows the correct pattern IS known in the same file: FinancialReportsPage receives error={activeQuery.error instanceof Error ? activeQuery.error.message : null}. The dashboard (and the Invoice/Payment list wrappers above it) omit it.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/main.tsx:28-35: the global QueryClient sets only staleTime + retry:1 — there is no QueryCache onError, no throwOnError, and no MutationCache. So swallowed query errors do NOT reach the top-level ErrorBoundary (main.tsx:50) either; the empty/zero fallback is the only thing the user sees. Landable frontend-only remedy: surface isError on the dashboard queries (pass an error prop like the reports route does) and/or add a QueryCache onError to the global QueryClient so read failures render an error/retry state instead of false zeros.
